# Bags

School Bags & Backpacks — Wholesale Supplier in India
We are a direct importer and wholesale supplier of bags and backpacks, supplying stationery retailers, school supply dealers, bag shops and online sellers across India at trade rates. This range covers school backpacks, kids character bags, 3D printed backpacks, sling and crossbody bags, tote and shoulder bags, travel duffles and drawstring bags.

Where the Real Basket Value Sits
A school bag is the single largest line item a parent buys at session start — typically ₹500 to ₹1,500 — and it is bought once a year with almost no comparison shopping if the design appeals to the child. For a stationery dealer, this is the item that turns a ₹300 sale into a ₹1,500 sale from the same customer walking through the same door. Character and 3D designs sell fastest because the child chooses, not the parent.

Wholesale Trade Terms

Importer pricing — direct factory sourcing from China

Low MOQ — mixed cartons across sizes and designs

Volume slabs — better rates at carton and master-carton levels

GST tax invoice on every consignment

Pan-India dispatch by surface and air cargo

Season Timing Is Everything
March to July is the school-session window, and it is decisive — a bag sold in March earns full margin, the same bag in August gets discounted. With roughly six-week import lead times, session stock has to be booked in January or February. Dealers who plan ahead capture the season; those who wait buy leftovers at higher cost.

Supplying Retailers Across India
We supply bags in bulk to stationery shops, school supply dealers, bag and luggage stores, general stores, gift retailers, mall kiosks and online sellers in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Pune, Jaipur, Lucknow, Patna, Indore and Surat. Looking for a school bag wholesaler or backpack importer supplying your city? We ship direct to your shop.
